summary: Create a pure-stdlib chance-corrected IRR module — Krippendorff's alpha (nominal/ordinal/interval, missing-data tolerant via the coincidence-matrix formulation), Fleiss' kappa (complete nominal matrices, loud ValueError otherwise), Cohen's kappa (2 fixed raters), select_irr_metric() encoding the paper's Figure 1 decision tree with P8 rationale strings, unit-level bootstrap percentile CIs (gap #2: at 3-20 cases the interval IS the finding), and explicit degenerate handling with machine-checkable reason codes so WS6's gate can pass perfect-agreement degenerates while failing insufficient-data ones (verdict V3-1 correction #1, encoded once in IRRResult.passes_gate). Hard constraint verified in ensure_deps.py:59-104: only pyyaml/mlflow/anthropic/jinja2 ever reach .eval-venv, so no scipy/pandas anywhere; the module also does NOT live under anova/stats behind ANOVA_AVAILABLE (superseding V2-2's stale phrasing). Test fixtures are externally anchored: I fetched the paper's Apache-2.0 replication repo, found it has no custom alpha code or test vectors, but reconstructed its 20-unit x 4-rater Q4 matrix (author_codes.csv + results.csv, PARSE_ERR->missing) and reproduced ALL 7 published alpha values exactly (4-way 0.886 + six pairwise) with the specified formulation, plus the Krippendorff 2011 textbook example (nominal 0.743, interval 0.849, n=40 pairable) — decision: vendor both as attributed fixtures. API is designed against the verified consumer call shapes: WS6 builds unit rows as stability.values + [None]*error_count (score.py:1190-1240) and treats errored pairwise verdicts as missing not a nominal category (verdict #5); WS8 gets the 2-fixed-rater Cohen path with caller-side null-join exclusion; WS2 gets the min_units policy-floor parameter (~10) on nominal alpha. Rationale strings cite Sec 5.3 (never 6.4, verdict #7), carry the Appendix A.1 varied-identity rule, and contain no Landis-Koch labels; the docstring mandates the 'single-judge self-consistency alpha (upper bound on IRR)' labeling consumers must use (verdict #6). Full plan at /Users/antonin/.claude/plans/mossy-roaming-phoenix-agent-a0ddf1fd532103052.md.

changes.spec: Pure-stdlib module (~400 lines; imports only math/statistics/random/dataclasses/collections/itertools/typing). Constants: NOMINAL/ORDINAL/INTERVAL + LEVELS frozenset; reason codes REASON_PERFECT_AGREEMENT ('perfect-agreement': D_e==0/p_e==1, every included rating identical, coefficient 0/0), REASON_INSUFFICIENT_UNITS ('insufficient-units': pairable units < min_units), REASON_NO_PAIRABLE_RATINGS ('no-pairable-ratings': no unit with >=2 non-missing ratings); DEFAULT_MIN_UNITS=2 (structural floor; policy floors like WS2's ~10 are caller-supplied via min_units). Dataclasses: ConfidenceInterval(low, high, confidence, method='bootstrap-percentile', n_boot, n_effective, seed) with to_dict() rounding to 3 decimals; IRRResult(metric, value: float|None, n_units, n_ratings, level=None, n_raters=None, reason=None, rationale=None, ci=None, ci_reason=None) with passes_gate(min_value)->bool returning True iff reason==REASON_PERFECT_AGREEMENT or value>=min_value (encodes verdict V3-1 #1: perfect-agreement degenerates pass the gate, errors/samples:1 fail), and to_dict() -> YAML-safe dict (always metric/value/n_units/n_ratings; optional keys only when not None; value/ci rounded to 3; .value itself stays full precision for gating). Functions: (1) krippendorff_alpha(units, level='nominal', *, min_units=DEFAULT_MIN_UNITS) -> IRRResult — units is an iterable of per-unit rating rows, None=missing, ragged rows allowed; ValueError on unknown level or (for ordinal/interval) any bool or non-numeric rating (bool-is-int trap per composite.py invariant); coincidence-matrix algorithm verified this session against both oracles: drop units with <2 ratings, each unit with m ratings adds weight 1/(m-1) to o[a,b] and o[b,a] per unordered pair, margins n_c, alpha=1-D_o/D_e with D_o=(1/n)*sum(o[c,k]*delta), D_e=(1/(n(n-1)))*sum(n_c*n_k*delta); delta nominal 0/1, interval (c-k)^2, ordinal (sum_{c<=g<=k} n_g - (n_c+n_k)/2)^2 over sorted distinct observed values; degenerate returns (never exceptions): no pairable units -> REASON_NO_PAIRABLE_RATINGS, < min_units -> REASON_INSUFFICIENT_UNITS, D_e==0 -> REASON_PERFECT_AGREEMENT; documented quirk: True/1 hash-merge as nominal categories. (2) fleiss_kappa(units, *, min_units) -> IRRResult — complete nominal matrices only (equal-length rows, n_raters>=2, no None) else ValueError pointing at alpha ('missing ratings force alpha per Figure 1'); classic Fleiss 1971 P_bar/P_e; P_e==1 -> REASON_PERFECT_AGREEMENT. (3) cohen_kappa(ratings_a, ratings_b, *, min_units) -> IRRResult — equal-length, no None (callers exclude null-join rows first, verdict V3-2 #6) else ValueError; unweighted nominal; p_e==1 (provably implies p_o==1) -> REASON_PERFECT_AGREEMENT; n_raters=2. (4) select_irr_metric(n_raters, varying_identity, complete_matrix, scale) -> (metric_name, rationale) — Figure 1 tree in order: bad scale/n_raters<2 -> ValueError; scale!=nominal -> alpha (rationale cites Sec 5.3 near-miss weighting); incomplete -> alpha; varying_identity -> alpha (Appendix A.1 varied-identity pool); n_raters==2 -> cohen ('the only design where Cohen's kappa is structurally valid'); else fleiss; rationales ship in reports (P8), no Landis-Koch adjectives, no '6.4'. (5) bootstrap_ci(units, statistic, *, n_boot=1000, confidence=0.95, seed=0, min_effective_fraction=0.5) -> ConfidenceInterval|None — unit-level (cluster) resampling with replacement via random.Random(seed); statistic returns None on degenerate resamples which are skipped and counted (n_effective); returns None when len(units)<2 or n_effective < max(2, ceil(n_boot*min_effective_fraction)); percentile method with linear interpolation; deterministic under seed. (6) compute_irr(units, scale, *, varying_identity=True, min_units=DEFAULT_MIN_UNITS, ci=True, n_boot=1000, confidence=0.95, seed=0) -> IRRResult — one-call wrapper for WS6/WS2: derives complete_matrix (equal-length, no None) and n_raters from data, runs select_irr_metric, dispatches (cohen splits the two columns), attaches rationale, bootstraps the same coefficient when point value defined (else fills ci_reason); graceful pre-condition: max row width <2 returns IRRResult(metric='krippendorff_alpha', value=None, reason=REASON_NO_PAIRABLE_RATINGS) so samples:1 data yields a stable dict shape, no exception. Deliberately excluded: percent-agreement helpers (uncorrected numbers stay consumer-side, labeled there) and P3 dual reporting (WS6 calls fleiss_kappa itself on complete matrices — per-case completeness check len(stability.values)==samples per verdict #8 — and surfaces kappa-vs-alpha divergence). Module docstring mandates: unit-row recipe values+[None]*error_count, errored-pairwise-verdicts-are-missing rule (verdict #5), 'single-judge self-consistency alpha (upper bound on IRR)' labeling (verdict #6), paper/Figure-1/A.1 citations with Sec 5.3 not 6.4 (verdict #7). No bootstrap import or agent_eval symlink needed: library module, not a skill script (tests/test_venv_activation.py scope verified); stdlib-only so it imports outside the venv.

~450 lines, plain pytest, fixtures inline as module constants with attribution comments. Known-value oracles: KRIPPENDORFF_2011 4x12 matrix (A=[1,2,3,3,2,1,4,1,2,-,-,-], B=[1,2,3,3,2,2,4,1,2,5,-,3], C=[-,3,3,3,2,3,4,2,2,5,1,-], D=[1,2,3,3,2,4,4,1,2,5,1,-]) -> nominal 0.743 with n_units==11/n_ratings==40, interval 0.849, ordinal 0.815 (pinned this session; authoring-time cross-check vs PyPI krippendorff, dev-only); REPLICATION_REPO_Q4 20x[author,qwen,gemma,nemotron] from the Apache-2.0 repo (A1/A2/F3/F4/G1/G2/I2/I3/I4=ABSx4, B1=[OK,OK,OK,INC], C1=OKx4, C4=[OK,OK,OK,None], C5=[OK,MM,OK,None], D1=[MM,MM,INC,None], D2=MMx4, E1/E3/I0=INCx4, H1=MMx4, I1=[OK,OK,OK,None]) -> 4-way 0.886 plus pairwise 0.930/0.929/0.901/0.859/0.901/0.901 (all 7 verified reproduced this session); Fleiss Wikipedia 10x14 example -> 0.210; Cohen [[20,5],[10,15]] -> 0.4 exact; Cohen chance A=[x,x,y,y] B=[x,y,x,y] -> 0.0 exact; alpha systematic disagreement [[a,b],[b,a]] -> -0.5 exact (hand derivation in comment). Degenerates: parametrized perfect-agreement across all 5 coefficient/level combos -> value None + REASON_PERFECT_AGREEMENT + passes_gate(0.8) True; insufficient-units floor incl. WS2-style min_units=10 on 5 units -> passes_gate False; no-pairable-ratings on single-rated rows and empty input; unpairable unit dropped from n_units; [3,3,None] rows equal the None-free equivalent. Misuse: fleiss rejects incomplete/ragged (ValueError mentioning alpha), cohen rejects mismatch/None, alpha rejects bad level and bool/non-numeric under ordinal/interval. Selection: parametrized decision-table test over the full truth table incl. ordinal-beats-panel and n_raters=1 ValueError; rationale hygiene test (non-empty, no 'slight/fair/moderate/substantial/almost perfect/Landis', no '6.4'). Ordinal-vs-nominal divergence: adjacent 1-5 disagreements ordinal>nominal; extreme (1 vs 5) ordinal(extreme)<ordinal(adjacent). Bootstrap: deterministic under seed; CI brackets 0.886 point estimate on REPLICATION_REPO_Q4 with bounds in [-1,1]; n_effective<n_boot when some resamples degenerate; all-degenerate -> None; compute_irr fills ci_reason. compute_irr end-to-end: bool-judge shape -> alpha+rationale+ci; 2 fixed raters nominal complete varying_identity=False -> cohen; single-sample rows -> graceful None+REASON_NO_PAIRABLE_RATINGS. Serialization: to_dict yaml.safe_dump round-trip, 3-decimal rounding, None-key omission, nested ci. Quirk pin: True/1 nominal merge. Purity enforcement: ast-parse the module and assert every import is in sys.stdlib_module_names; subprocess bare-interpreter import test (tests/test_bootstrap.py pattern).
